# MRMhub

::: {.lead}
Reproducible, automated and scalable processing of targeted metabolomics and lipidomics data
:::

::: {.title-sep}
:::

**MRMhub** is an automated, scalable framework for processing targeted metabolomics and
lipidomics data acquired by liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (LC-MS) in multiple
reaction monitoring (MRM) mode. It provides a reproducible, end-to-end workflow — from raw
instrument data to quality-controlled quantitative results — at population scale on standard
hardware. Its two modules, **MRMhub-INTEGRATOR** and **MRMhub-QUANT**, cover peak integration,
quantification, quality control, and reporting, recording a full digital footprint of every
step for reproducibility and traceability. Modular functions and defined data structures adapt
to diverse study designs and data formats, and support collaboration between analytical and
bioinformatics scientists.

## The MRMhub modules

Both are customizable and can be used together or independently:

::: {.module-list}
- **[INTEGRATOR ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/integrator/)** — a consensus-based
  peak integrator that accurately and consistently determines peak
  boundaries in complex chromatograms across an analysis sequence. Fully supervised and
  customizable for large datasets.
- **[QUANT ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/)** — a programmatic R library
  (`mrmhub`) for analysis post-processing and quality control: data validation, quantification,
  correction of analytical artifacts, outlier detection, feature filtering, dataset export, and
  QC reporting. It also imports intensity data from Skyline, generic CSV, and mzTab-M files.
:::

## Getting started

::: {.arrow-list}
- **Run the demo** — download the [latest MRMhub release](https://github.com/SLINGhub/MRMhub/releases) and follow the `readme.txt`, or the [demo walkthrough](get-started.html), to process the bundled demo project end-to-end with both modules - no data of your own required.
- **Browse real analyses** — [mrmhub-workflows ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/mrmhub-workflows/) showcases annotated, end-to-end data-processing reports from large-scale lipidomics studies.
- **Read the module docs** — tutorials and detailed instructions for each module: [INTEGRATOR ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/integrator/) and [QUANT ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/).
:::
